declarations.docstring: Short exact complexes whose left and right endpoints are identified with `X` and `Z`, respectively.
The isomorphism from the left endpoint of the associated short exact complex to `X`.
The isomorphism from the right endpoint of the associated short exact complex to `Z`.
The short exact complex associated with an extension.
An alternative short exact complex associated with an extension.
The type of short exact complexes in a category with zero morphisms.
Regard a short exact complex as an extension of its right endpoint by its left endpoint.
A short complex in an abelian category is short exact exactly when its first map is mono, its second map is epi, and the induced cokernel morphism is an isomorphism.
